dialogue.patient: I'm all foggy. I can't remember things.
It stings when I pass water.
My back hurts. The right side. A lot.
I feel sick. I haven't been sick, though.
No cough. My tummy's all right. My chest doesn't hurt.
…I haven't passed any water for hours.
Sugar diabetes. And I've had kidney stones. I take metformin and something for the pressure.
